style: Flat painted illustration. Bold contour, limited earth palette, no photoreal skin, no cinematic lighting, no Marvel or God of War armor, no modern clothes. Figures in profile or three-quarter like a Greek vase that someone cleaned up. Night interior, warm dark ground.

shots.spoken: Everyone knows Zeus. Ask a room who his brothers and sisters are and the room goes quiet.
shots.prompt: A seated king of the sky, eagle at his side, no thunderbolt hero pose, Greek vase profile, night hall, other seats around him empty.

shots.spoken: Hesiod names six in one breath. Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, Zeus. Each of them took a piece of the world.
shots.prompt: Six adult gods in a row, eldest to youngest left to right, hearth, grain, crown, dark helm, wave, and a younger sky king, same clothes language, no Roman names on the picture.

shots.spoken: Most people cannot name them. Can you? Five minutes. The line is in the Theogony.
